newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent steady, but seen supported by API.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent steady, but seen supported by API.

text.p: June Brent crude futures in Asia were untraded at midday but were expected to be supported by the API data overnight, brokers said.
June Brent on SIMEX was quoted at $18.05/$18.20 per barrel after London gained 10 cents to close at $18.07.
NYMEX June crude was last traded at $19.74 per barrel, up eight cents from New York, implying a June Brent value around $18.15 on Tuesday's arbitrage of $1.59.

Brokers said the API data would underpin crude after it showed a crude draw of 1.9 million barrels excluding the often-ignored PADD 5 west coast region. Nationally, stocks rose 1.02 million, when a two million rise had been expected.
Implied demand for gasoline was at record levels, although traders said the calculation was not always reliable, especially so early in the season.
Nevertheless, the data boosted NYMEX gasoline on ACCESS.
It was last traded at 60.95 cents per gallon, up 0.64 cent from New York and reversing New York's 0.23 losses.
